page.overview:
Who is Koros?

Koros is a Warsmith of the Iron Warriors Traitor Legion who is active in defending the Chaos worlds near to the Hadex Anomaly in thew Jericho Reach.

Warsmith Koros is a veteran of the battle of the Iron Cage, and one of the Daemon Primarch Perturabo's lieutenants, having proved himself worthy of command of one of the Iron Bastions on Medrengard, the Daemon World which is home to his Legion.

Koros has been dispatched to the Jericho Reach in order to oversee the fortification of numerous worlds about the Hadex Anomaly, and to lend his assistance in the planning of a grand counterstrike against the forces of the Imperium involved in the Achilus Crusade to retake the region.

What price the various Chaos factions opposing the Imperium have agreed to pay in return for the Iron Warriors' aid is not known, but it must certainly be high.
